summary: Glucotrack filed an 8-K reporting two routine items: an amendment to previously issued PIPE common warrants and the voting results of a September 11, 2026 special meeting. The September 14, 2026 amendment blocks exercise of the common warrants and issuance of underlying shares until stockholders approve the issuance under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(d). Stockholders considered proposals tied to a July 14, 2026 equity line of credit purchase agreement with White Lion Capital, covering shares potentially exceeding 20% of outstanding common stock. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium, or acquisition terms were stated; no special-situation transaction is present.
